_horizon_comment: How long a signed collection or declaration may stand, measured from interpretation.decided_at.
decided_at is an honest anchor for THIS piece, and it is not for most. Elsewhere it rewards
signing late: a claim about March, signed in August, gets its clock started in August. Here it
cannot, because the thing the claim is about is pinned by structure_digest rather than by date.
A signature cannot outlive the structure it was given for, whatever the calendar says.
special_category is shorter because GDPR Article 9 data — and Article 10 criminal-offence
data — is the part of a data map that hurts most when it is wrong or out of date.
_agent_horizon_comment: The ceiling for a collection an agent renewed, measured from the agent's decided_at. A
repository's .noru/interpretation-policy.yml may set a shorter one and never a longer one.
Shorter than horizon_days on purpose. An agent may only renew a collection whose structure is
byte-for-byte what a person last signed, and the next renewal after an agent's is a person's,
so this bounds how long a classification can stand on an agent's word before a person looks.
